sloka: रथाङ्गसाह्वा नत्यूहा: हंसा: कारण्डवा: प्लवा: ।तथा पुंस्कोकिला: क्रौञ्चा विसंज्ञा भेजिरे दिश: ॥ २.१०२.४३॥
transliteration: rathāṅgasāhvā natyūhā: haṁsā: kāraṇḍavā: plavā: ।tathā puṁskokilā: krauñcā visaṁjñā bhejire diśa: ॥ 2.102.43॥

translations.english: Ducks, watercranes, geese, karandavas, cranes, male cuckoos and kraunchas fled senselessly in different directions.
